You guys are good DMs, and I can tell you really love what you do. I just don't think *I* mesh with you guys, and I'm sorry about that. I think I will leave, maybe come back next year. I really loved this place, at least back in London where life was simpler. Man, you guys've mastered *forcing me into character* (In a good way, coming from someone who acts onstage). I just don't think I'm the right fit, I don't think my mental health is in the best place, and I don't want that to negatively impact me *or* the other members of the server. I'd really like to play with some of you again someday, but for now I just want to return to pseudo-happy times. 

If you wanna hear me whine: ||Also it may be related to the facts I've had persistent depression and PTSD for years, that I'm coming out as trans and bi in a small town where I've been beaten with sticks, today is the anniversary of my really close family member's death, that the world is in shambles, and other factors.||

@everyone 
Home brew rules for this:

-There will be instant death! Some things will instantly kill you! I am not holding back. 
However if you die you will immediately be plopped back to safety. With none of your stuff. Your stuff will be where you died, so you can recollect it. This will create consequences for your actions; but still allow the game to continue

-No PVP, I don’t want the game slowed down.
However that doesn’t mean you can’t “accidentally” cause someone’s death...

-if combat does engage, and you do not instantly tell me what you are doing you will be skipped. I don’t mean to be rude, but I can’t slow down with how many people there are hoping onto this

-if you go down in combat it is an instant death. You will be plopped back into the game without your stuff, just like the first rule says. This allows you to keep going without waisting your time rolling death saves

-no stealing from other players. If you don’t like your stuff you had your chance :p there MAY be loot that is found in game.
